unlisted_practices: LLM-driven iterative adaptive weight optimization for radiotherapy treatment planning
RAG clinical knowledge base to improve LLM domain-specific reasoning in treatment planning

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an iterative LLM and RAG-based framework for adaptive weight optimization in seed implant brachytherapy (SIBT) planning on 23 retrospective patient cases. While RAG and iterative loops are used, they constitute the proposed optimization architecture rather than evaluating a deployment safeguard or practice.
